title: Color Belt · Screen 2 · Picking a date (CB11)
subtitle: Already decided (v1.018): Star's date picker replaces the browser's date box everywhere. In Color Belt that's four fields: Add / Edit event's testing date and closing date, the private day (Add private testing, Change day or time, Move to private testing) and Edit payment's date paid. One question at the bottom. (Preview screenshots, fake data; the “after” is drawn on the real page, nothing is built yet.)

items.caption: 1. Edit event: the browser's box (looks different on the PC, the iPad and a phone), and a weekday line under it.
2. Closing date: the same box and weekday line.

row.caption: 3. Change day or time (and Add private testing).

columns.label: After · PC

items.caption: 1. Star's picker: the field says “Fri, Nov 20, 2026”; a click opens Month · Year and the days. Gray days can't be picked.
2. The weekday line goes (the field already says the day). The “11:59 PM, Massachusetts time…” line stays.

columns.note: Days that can be picked (gray = no), as Color Belt and Star check today: testing date — today or later; closing date — today up to the testing date; private day — today up to a year ahead; date paid — not after today (the database already refuses a later day).

columns.label: After · tablet 820 · phone 390 · 320 wide

row.caption: Tablet: the calendar floats under the field.
Phone: the calendar opens in the page, edge to edge.
320 wide: the same, nothing cut off.

columns.note: This is Star's picker exactly as it works today on each size — Color Belt only uses it.

footer:
One question — the earliest “date paid”. Today Color Belt's date paid takes any day up to today. Star's (the picker we're copying) also refuses a day before the person registered, and says so under the days: “Not before Oct 18 (registered) or after today.”
A · Recommended: copy Star — not before the day they registered (private testing: the day it was added), not after today, with that line. + catches a typo like 2025 for 2026; the same rule in both sections. − a payment taken before the registration can't be entered (it shouldn't happen: the desk registers first).
B · Only “not after today” (what the database checks). + nothing new. − a wrong year goes through and lands on the wrong day in Finance's Daily report.
